Job Overview
Role Summary
We are seeking a PLC / Automation Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on controller development, HMI solutions, industrial automation, and AGV implementation. The role involves developing PLC-based control systems aligned with project requirements, supporting machine integration, and contributing throughout testing, commissioning, and production start-up activities.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop PLC-based control systems in accordance with project requirements.
Develop, maintain, and improve HMI terminals and operator interfaces.
Participate in system testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project start-up activities.
Manage machine interfaces related to machine procurement and integration.
Program and implement AGV solutions within the automation environment.
Contribute to high-level system architecture, strategic planning, and system design.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and maintain clear technical documentation.
Support testing activities that may occasionally require evening or weekend work.

Technical Stack & Requirements
PLC programming and PLC-based control systems.
HMI design, development, and programming.
SCADA systems.
AGV programming and implementation.
Industrial automation and machine interfaces.
High-level architecture, strategic planning, and system design.
TCP/IP networking.
Experience with vision systems is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
The ideal candidate holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline. Several years of practical experience working with PLC solutions is required, together with experience in HMI design and programming and knowledge of SCADA systems. Candidates should have a solid understanding of TCP/IP networks and be comfortable contributing to architecture and system-design discussions. Experience with vision systems is considered advantageous. Strong English communication skills are required; Swedish language skills are beneficial.

ENGLISH BELOW
Privat hushållerska
För en svensk företagare bosatt i Göteborg, Sverige, och Nice, Frankrike, söker vi en privat hushållerska. 
Arbetsuppgifterna innebär att sköta en stor bostad i centrala Göteborg och inkluderar:
• Städning
• Tvättning och strykning
• Skötsel av växter
• Vård av möbler
• Matlagning (ett veganskt mål per dag)
Lönen är 217,89 kr/h plus 12% semesterersättning och boende erbjuds, antingen i bostadens jungfrukammare eller i en närliggande separat lägenhet.
Arbetstiden uppskattas till 25-40 h per vecka, och kan delvis anpassas efter dina önskemål. Tjänsten, som utgör en vanlig anställning med full lön, kan även passa dig som överväger arbete som au pair.
För att ansöka, skriv en ärlig presentation av dig (personlighet, kunskaper inom hushållning och planer i livet), utan att använda AI, på det språk du föredrar, och skicka denna tillsammans med meritförteckning till housekeeper@servia.com.

Private Housekeeper
On behalf of a Swedish entrepreneur, residing in Gothenburg, Sweden, and Nice, France, we are looking for a private housekeeper.
The role involves looking after a large residence in central Gothenburg and includes:
• Cleaning
• Laundry and ironing
• Plant care
• Furniture care
• Cooking (one vegan meal per day)
The salary is SEK 217.89 per hour plus 12% holiday pay, and accommodation is provided, either in the residence's maid's quarters or in a nearby separate apartment.
Working hours are estimated at 25–40 hours per week and can partly be adapted to your preferences. The position, which is regular employment with full pay, may also suit you if you are considering work as an au pair.
To apply, write an honest presentation of yourself (personality, housekeeping skills and plans in life), without using AI, in your preferred language, and send it together with your CV to housekeeper@servia.com.

We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Specialist in surgery/general surgery for permanent position in central Sweden
Are you a skilled surgeon / general surgery specialist looking for your next career move? We are supporting a well-established healthcare provider in Sweden in their search for a motivated specialist to join their surgical team.
About the role
Work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary team with a focus on patient-centered care
Manage a diverse mix of elective and acute surgical cases
Opportunities to utilize your expertise fully and develop subspecialty skills

Why this role is attractive
Mentorship and professional guidance from experienced colleagues
Regular opportunities for continued professional development
Supportive work environment with wellness benefits

Who we are looking for
Certified Specialist in Surgery / General Surgery
Team player who values collaboration across specialties
Committed to delivering high-quality, safe surgical care
Looking for a professionally rewarding role in a region offering an excellent quality of life

What Dignus Medical Offers You:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with Swedish authorization and specialist recognition, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for accompanying family members
Access to a free Swedish language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Qualifications:
EU-recognized specialist certification in surgery 
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

Interested in new opportunities?
Contact us to discuss available positions and find a role that fits your professional profile.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably.
You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability.
Key responsibilities
Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling.

Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution.

Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management.

Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities.

Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation.

Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security.

Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes.

Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required.

Required qualifications
Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role.

Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments.

Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM.

Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics.

Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.

Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible.

Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure.

Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.
